description: This file handles the processing of 'Add' messages in a USP (User Services Platform) agent, including parsing requests, resolving object paths, managing transactions, creating objects, and generating responses. It specifically manages partial and non-partial add operations, error handling, and response formation.

classes.name: group_add_vector_t
classes.description: A data structure used to temporarily hold objects to be added, including success and error states.

classes.name: group_add_entry_t
classes.description: Represents an individual object addition attempt, including paths, error codes, and parameters.

classes.name: group_add_param_t
classes.description: Represents parameters related to object creation, including their status and errors.

methods.name: void MSG_HANDLER_HandleAdd(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Main handler function for processing incoming Add messages, determining their validity, and routing to appropriate processing functions.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ProcessAdd_AllowPartialTrue(char * msg_id,Usp__Msg * usp,combined_role_t * combined_role)
methods.description: Processes an Add request with allow_partial set to true, attempting to create all objects and recording individual success or failure.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ProcessAdd_AllowPartialFalse(char * msg_id,Usp__Msg * usp,combined_role_t * combined_role)
methods.description: Processes an Add request with allow_partial set to false, rolling back all changes if any object creation fails.

methods.name: int ResolveObjectsToAdd(Usp__Add__CreateObject * cr,group_add_vector_t * gav,combined_role_t * combined_role,bool allow_partial)
methods.description: Resolves a path expression to a set of objects to add, and populates the group add vector accordingly.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateFullAddResp(char * msg_id,group_add_vector_t * gav)
methods.description: Creates a detailed add response message based on the results stored in the group add vector.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateBasicAddResp(char * msg_id)
methods.description: Creates an initial, empty add response message for further population.

methods.name: Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * AddResp_OperSuccess(Usp__AddResp * add_resp,char * req_path,char * path)
methods.description: Adds a success entry to an add response message.

methods.name: Usp__AddResp__ParameterError * AddResp_OperSuccess_ParamErr(Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * oper_success,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a parameter error entry to an operation success object.

methods.name: void AddOperSuccess_UniqueKeys(Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * oper_success,kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Transfers unique key mappings into an operation success object.

methods.name: Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationFailure * AddResp_OperFailure(Usp__AddResp * add_resp,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a failure entry to an add response message.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateAddResponseError(char * msg_id,group_add_entry_t * gae)
methods.description: Creates an error response message based on the failure to create an object.

methods.name: bool AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId(Usp__Add * add)
methods.description: Checks if all object paths in a request target the same data model group.

methods.name: int CalcGroupIdForPath(char * path_expr)
methods.description: Calculates the group ID for a given path, considering reference following and search expressions.
